frozen_backbone_policy: for frozen pretrained LLM backbones, persist repository id, exact revision, file manifest and hashes instead of duplicating immutable multi-gigabyte backbone files; trainable adapter / projection / alignment weights plus a restoration recipe are stored in full

restoration_check.requirement: at least one compute-node restoration check per distinct architecture family, using only the durable Screening package plus verified immutable backbone assets
restoration_check.must_reproduce: saved validation predictions within the preregistered numerical tolerance
